title: Scalar transport of duality-pullback-duality inclusion components
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, prime l distinct from D.p, algebraic closure Omega of Q_l in an independent universe, separated finite-type D.k-schemes X,Y, separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X to Y, and common-stage dualities BX,BY [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data]. For finite coefficient fields E≤L in Omega and M in the E-stage on Y, form delta from beta_X on pullback_E(DY_E M), followed by DX_L of the opposite composite pullback_L(beta_Y inverse) and inverse pullback scalar comparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Write r_E(M) for BX.comparison followed by BX.dual of the opposite composite pullback(BY.comparison inverse) and inverse pullbackInclusion. Then inclusion_L(delta) followed by r_L(transition_Y M) equals inclusionTransition_X on DX_E(pullback_E(DY_E M)), followed by r_E(M), followed by (DY.rightOp then pullback.op then DX) applied to inverse inclusionTransition_Y on M. No exceptional functor, compactification, core or exceptional comparison occurs.

proof.text: Fix the finite-field datum, l, Omega, X,Y,f, BX,BY and E≤L as in the statement. Put K=pullback_E(DY_E M). Expand delta as beta_X(K) followed by DX_L of the opposite of pullback_L(beta_Y inverse) and inverse pullback scalar comparison. Naturality of BX.comparison moves the latter map through the BX comparison at L. The scalar clause of BX.properties and betaNormalized replace beta_X with inclusionTransition_X and the BX comparison at E, leaving DX applied to inverse inclusionTransition_X.

In the remaining contravariant argument use naturality and the scalar square of pullbackInclusion to move the inverse pullback scalar comparison through its inclusions. Invert the BY.properties scalar equation, substituting betaNormalized, to replace the inverse beta_Y and BY comparisons by DY applied to inverse inclusionTransition_Y. Functoriality combines the factors and the adjacent inclusionTransition_X inverse/forward maps cancel. This proves the displayed equation for all objects, including zero objects and repeated coefficient fields.

theorem dual_formula_inclusion_scalar
    (BX : Duality D l hl Ω X) (BY : Duality D l hl Ω Y)
    (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) (M : Stage l Ω Y E) :
    (inclusion L).map
      ((BX.finite.scalar E L h).comparison.hom.app
          (op ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) _ _ _ X Y f
            (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj
              ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M)))) ≫
        (BX.finite.datum L).dual.map
          (((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _ X Y f
              (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).map
              ((BY.finite.scalar E L h).comparison.inv.app (op M)) ≫
            (@rationalPullbackScalarComparison l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) _ _ _
              (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) X Y f
              (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).inv.app
                ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M))).op)) ≫
      (BX.comparison L).hom.app
        (op ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) _ _ _ X Y f
          (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj
            ((BY.finite.datum L).dual.obj (op ((transition l Ω Y E L h).obj M))))) ≫
      BX.duality.dual.map
        ((CoefQbarPullback D l hl Ω f).map
          ((BY.comparison L).inv.app (op ((transition l Ω Y E L h).obj M))) ≫
          (pullbackInclusion D l hl Ω X f L
            ((BY.finite.datum L).dual.obj (op ((transition l Ω Y E L h).obj M)))).inv).op =
    (inclusionTransition l Ω X E L h).hom.app
      ((BX.finite.datum E).dual.obj
        (op ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) _ _ _ X Y f
          (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj
            ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M))))) ≫
      (BX.comparison E).hom.app
        (op ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) _ _ _ X Y f
          (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj
            ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M)))) ≫
      BX.duality.dual.map
        ((CoefQbarPullback D l hl Ω f).map ((BY.comparison E).inv.app (op M)) ≫
          (pullbackInclusion D l hl Ω X f E
            ((BY.finite.datum E).dual.obj (op M))).inv).op ≫
      (BY.duality.dual.rightOp ⋙ (CoefQbarPullback D l hl Ω f).op ⋙ BX.duality.dual).map
        ((inclusionTransition l Ω Y E L h).inv.app M)
